meta.generatedFrom: TypeScript (the parity contract — never regenerate from Rust)
meta.description: The exported constants, at full f64 precision.
notes: MISPRICING_PHI = Math.pow(0.5, 1/60) is a TRANSCENDENTAL RESULT computed by V8 at module load. Rust f64::powf may differ in the last ULP. The port must reproduce these bits — hardcoding the literal from `MISPRICING_PHI.bits` is the safe move, since a one-ULP difference in phi compounds through the whole s-process.
1/60 is itself inexact; `phiDerivation.exponent` records the exact f64 that Math.pow received.
meta.floatEncoding: bits = raw IEEE-754 f64, big-endian, 16 uppercase hex digits. dec = shortest round-trip decimal, informational only.
meta.nanPolicy: Every NaN is recorded as 7FF8000000000000 (the pattern of Rust f64::NAN). V8 does not emit a stable NaN sign/payload, so only NaN-ness is contractual — compare NaN results with is_nan(), not with bits.
